rows.note: Use 推 as the all-purpose verb for physically moving something away, and colloquially for actively promoting an idea or product.
This is the all-purpose noun for the physical force of a push.

example.english: The push from this motor is strong enough to open the gate.
example.traditional: 呢部摩打嘅推力夠推開道閘喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 mo1 daa2 ge3 teoi1 lik6 gau3 teoi1 hoi1 dou6 zaap6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for effort invested in getting something done, rather than physical force.

example.english: I had to push hard to get this report right.
example.traditional: 為咗整好呢份報告，我落咗好多功夫。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 zing2 hou2 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 lok6 zo2 hou2 do1 gung1 fu1

rows.note: Use 催 when repeatedly urging or pressuring someone to act, decide, or provide an answer.

example.english: Don't push me anymore; I'll definitely give you an answer tomorrow.
example.traditional: 你唔好再催我喇，我聽日一定畀答覆你。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 ceoi1 ngo5 laa3 ngo5 ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 bei2 daap3 fuk1 nei5

rows.note: Use this when the push is pressure that makes someone act.

example.english: The pressure from my boss gave me the push to deliver today.
example.traditional: 老闆畀嘅壓力，令我今日一定要交貨。
example.jyutping: lou5 baan2 bei2 ge3 aat3 lik6 ling6 ngo5 gam1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gaau1 fo3

rows.note: Use 谷自己 when pushing yourself to work harder toward a goal.

example.english: To train for the marathon, I push myself to run every day.
example.traditional: 為咗跑馬拉松，我日日谷自己練跑。
example.jyutping: wai6 zo2 paau2 maa5 laai1 sung1 ngo5 jat6 jat6 guk1 zi6 gei2 lin6 paau2

rows.note: Use this for an organized attempt to persuade someone to take a particular action.

example.english: The lawmakers are making a push to win support for this amendment.
example.traditional: 議員正進行遊說，爭取支持呢項修訂。
example.jyutping: ji5 jyun4 zing3 zeon3 hang4 jau4 seoi3 zaang1 ceoi2 zi1 ci4 ni1 hong6 sau1 ding6

rows.note: Use 用力 in childbirth or bowel-movement contexts when someone is told to bear down.

example.english: The doctor said, “Push, the baby is almost here!”
example.traditional: 醫生話：用力呀，就快生得喇！
example.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 jung6 lik6 aa3 zau6 faai3 saang1 dak1 laa3
